Important update for all Cities: Skylines II Players:

STAB: A player says mods no longer appear in-game after a patch, so the game plays fully vanilla despite reinstalling.
A player says the game is buggy and overheats their machine, and the developer is neglecting needed updates.
PERF: A player says the game becomes a mess and unplayable once a city passes roughly ten thousand residents.
A player says optimization updates are very slow, large cities max out the CPU, and mod plans keep being delayed.
CONTENT: A player says early access lacks mods, a map editor, and optimization, and nothing has improved two months later.
A player says the game is boring and offers nothing new beyond the first game.
DESIGN: A player says industry, economy, import/export, waste, and traffic are broken, so the game barely simulates a city.
A player says the game is dumbed down, industries and parks lack impact, and it feels bland beyond performance problems.
SUPPORT: A player says the game is beyond repair and they have lost hope that its many problems will be fixed.
A player says updates are slow and small, promised features were delayed, and a recent update corrupted their saves.
